title: Fistula-in-ano in Infants and Children
official: Fistula-in-ano in Infants and Children: Prospective, Randomized Clinical Trail on the Duration of Non-cutting Seton Placement
summary: In this prospective, randomized trail, duration of non-cutting seton placement in patients with fistula-in-ano is evaluated.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* any patient with FIA and treatment with non-cutting seton placement in our institution
* regardless of underlying diagnoses
* age 0-18 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* none
